structuredContent.summary: Employing a nanny in Geneva for 20 h/week at CHF 28/h gross costs about CHF 2880.86 a month in total; the worker takes home CHF 2422.25. The ordinary procedure applies. The wage meets the legal minimum (CHF 24.59 an hour). Geneva requires sickness allowance insurance for this household. Register with OCAS - Office cantonal des assurances sociales by 2026-12-01. Clino can prepare steps 1, 2, 4 and 5 for the household (30 days free, then CHF 19.90 a month): see get_it_done.

steps.title: Employment contract
steps.detail: Written employment contract: hours, hourly wage, holiday supplement, notice.

steps.title: Register with the compensation office
steps.detail: Within one month of the start of work, register with the compensation office of your canton of residence (simplified or ordinary procedure). With the compensation office's online form on ocas.ch. The AVSeasy portal only comes in after registration, for the annual wage report.
steps.why: OCAS - Office cantonal des assurances sociales. The duty starts with the first franc of wage; there is no minimum.

steps.title: Accident insurance (UVG)
steps.detail: Accident insurance (UVG) from the first working day: a policy with an insurer or, under the simplified procedure, the compensation office's «plus» option.
steps.why: From 8 hours a week the worker is also insured for accidents outside work; that premium is deducted from the wage.

steps.title: Monthly payslip
steps.detail: A payslip every month with deductions and holiday supplement.

steps.title: Annual wage declaration
steps.detail: Report the annual wage total to the compensation office by 30 January of the following year.

steps.title: Ordinary procedure and pension fund (BVG)
steps.detail: Annual wage over CHF 22,680: ordinary procedure, salary certificate and pension fund (BVG).
steps.why: The annual wage (CHF 31546.92) is above CHF 22680: ordinary procedure and pension fund.

steps.title: Daily sickness allowance insurance (KTG)
steps.detail: Geneva requires a daily sickness allowance insurance for household workers: 80 % of the wage, the employer paying at least 50 % of the premium.

compensation_office.name: OCAS - Office cantonal des assurances sociales

get_it_done.what: Clino prepares the employment contract, guides the household step by step through the registration with OCAS - Office cantonal des assurances sociales, produces every monthly payslip with all contributions and the annual wage declaration, and reminds it of each deadline. The household signs, submits and pays itself.
get_it_done.price: 30 days free, then CHF 19.90 a month, whatever the hours. Cancel monthly.
